title: Zhuyin initials
summary: The left column of Zhuyin: ㄅㄆㄇㄈ.

sections.p: ㄅ is b, ㄆ is p with more air, ㄇ is m, ㄈ is f.

drills.q: Which is p with a puff?
drills.why: ㄆ is aspirated p; ㄅ is plain.

title: Zhuyin finals
summary: Single finals ㄚㄛㄜㄝ and compound spellings.

sections.p: After an initial, finals carry the vowel. ㄚ is a, ㄛ is o, ㄜ is e.

drills.why: ㄜ is e as in 哥 gē.

title: Numbers 一–十
summary: Count with 一 to 十; 兩 before measure words for two.

sections.p: Use 兩 liǎng before classifiers: 兩個, not 二個 in Taiwan speech.
examples: ㄌㄧㄤˇ ㄍㄜˋ ㄆㄧㄥˊ ㄍㄨㄛˇ · Liǎng gè píngguǒ.

drills.why: 兩 before measure words for two.

title: 這 / 那 / 哪
summary: Near 這, far 那, question 哪.

sections.p: 這 zhè this, 那 nà that, 哪 nǎ which/where in questions.
examples: ㄓㄜˋ ㄕˋ ㄕㄜˊ ㄇㄜ˙? · Zhè shì shénme?

drills.why: 哪 in 哪裡 / 哪個.

sections.p: 誰 shéi who; 什麼 shénme what. Keep question word; verb at end.

title: 請 — please
summary: 請 qǐng please; 請進 come in; 請坐 please sit.

sections.p: 請 softens requests. 請問 opens questions politely.

title: 捷運 / 計程車
summary: Taiwan words for metro and taxi.

sections.p: Take 捷運 for the metro; call a 計程車, not 出租车.
examples: ㄨㄛˇ ㄗㄨㄛˋ ㄐㄧㄝˊ ㄩㄣˋ · Wǒ zuò jiéyùn.

title: 個 / 本 / 杯
summary: Common measure words with 一、兩、三.

sections.p: 個 gè general; 本 běn books; 杯 bēi cups.
examples: ㄧˋ ㄅㄣˇ ㄕㄨ · Yì běn shū.

title: 這裡 / 那裡 / 哪裡
summary: Place words for here, there, where.

sections.p: 這裡 here, 那裡 there, 哪裡 where. Taiwan also says 這邊/那邊 in speech.
examples: ㄒㄧˇ ㄕㄡˇ ㄐㄧㄢ ㄗㄞˋ ㄋㄚˇ ㄌㄧˇ? · Xǐshǒujiān zài nǎlǐ?

title: 今天 / 明天 / 昨天

sections.p: 今天 today, 明天 tomorrow, 昨天 yesterday.

drills.q: Time word order in TW Mandarin…

sections.p: Use 很 with adjectives: 今天很熱. 下雨 xiàyǔ rain; 颱風 táifēng typhoon (Taiwan).
examples: ㄐㄧㄣ ㄊㄧㄢ ㄏㄣˇ ㄌㄥˇ · Jīntiān hěn lěng.

title: 點餐 — ordering food
summary: Order in a shop or night market.

sections.p: 我要 I want; 請給我 please give me. Taiwan: 便當 biàndāng, 珍珠奶茶 zhēnzhū nǎichá.
examples: ㄨㄛˇ ㄧㄠˋ ㄧˋ ㄨㄢˇ ㄇㄧ�anˋ · Wǒ yào yì wǎn miàn.
I want a bowl of noodles.

drills.q: I want a bowl of noodles.

sections.p: 對不起 sorry; 沒關係 it's OK. 不好意思 excuse me (lighter).
在 + place: 在家 at home, 在公司 at the office. Negate existence with 不在.
examples: ㄨㄛˇ ㄗㄞˋ ㄐㄧㄚ · Wǒ zài jiā.

title: 有 / 沒有 review
summary: Have, there is; negate with 沒有.

sections.p: Expand 有: 有時間 have time, 有問題 have a problem. 沒有 + noun.
examples: ㄨㄛˇ ㄇ�eiˊ ㄧㄡˇ ㄨㄣˋ ㄊㄧˊ · Wǒ méiyǒu wèntí.

options: there is a problem / I have a question
drills.answer: there is a problem / I have a question

title: 了 — change of state
summary: 了 marks a new situation or completed change.

sections.p: 了 at end can mean something changed: 我餓了 I am hungry now (wasn't before).
examples: ㄨㄛˇ ㄜˋ ㄌㄜ˙ · Wǒ è le.

sections.p: 在 before verb: 我在寫報告 I am writing a report.
examples: ㄨㄛˇ ㄗㄞˋ ㄒㄧㄝˇ ㄅㄠˋ ㄍㄠˋ · Wǒ zài xiě bàogào.

sections.p: 去過 have been (there); 吃過 have eaten before.
examples: ㄨㄛˇ ㄑㄩˋ ㄍㄨㄛˋ ㄊㄞˊ ㄅ�eiˇ · Wǒ qùguò Táiběi.

title: 比 — compare (review)
summary: A 比 B + adj: A is more … than B.

sections.p: 台灣的夏天比英國熱。Use 更 for even more in some contexts.
examples: ㄓㄜˋ ㄍㄜ˙ ㄅㄧˇ ㄋㄚˋ ㄍㄜ˙ ㄉㄚˋ · Zhège bǐ nàge dà.

options: no 很 before adj in 比 sentence
drills.answer: no 很 before adj in 比 sentence

title: 一下 — briefly
summary: Verb + 一下 do something briefly.

sections.p: 看一下 take a look; 等一下 wait a moment.
examples: ㄑㄧㄥˇ ㄉㄥˇ ㄧˊ ㄒㄧ�aˋ · Qǐng děng yíxià.

sections.p: 他還在 he is still here; 我也去 I am going too.
examples: ㄨㄛˇ ㄧㄝˇ ㄧㄠˋ · Wǒ yě yào.

sections.p: 這裡可以拍照 You may take photos here. 我不可以 I cannot.
examples: ㄨㄛˇ ㄎㄜˇ ㄧˇ ㄐㄧㄣˋ ㄑㄩˋ ㄇㄚ˙? · Wǒ kěyǐ jìnqù ma?

options: 可以 = may/can; 會 = learned skill/will
drills.answer: 可以 = may/can; 會 = learned skill/will

sections.p: 因為…所以… because … therefore …
examples: ㄧ�n ㄨ�eiˋ ㄒㄧㄚˋ ㄩˇ, ㄙㄨㄛˇ ㄧˇ ㄨㄛˇ ㄇ�eiˊ ㄑㄩˋ · Yīnwei xiàyǔ, suǒyǐ wǒ méi qù.

sections.p: 雖然…但是… although … still …
examples: ㄙㄨㄟˊ ㄖㄢˊ ㄍㄨˋˋ, ㄉ�anˋ ㄕˋ ㄏㄣˇ ㄏㄠˇ · Suīrán guì, dànshì hěn hǎo.

sections.p: 如果…就… if … then …
examples: ㄖㄨˊ ㄍㄨㄛˇ ㄒㄧㄚˋ ㄩˇ, ㄐㄧㄡˋ ㄅㄨˋ ㄑㄩˋ · Rúguǒ xiàyǔ, jiù bù qù.

title: 把 — disposal (review)
summary: 把 + obj + verb: handle the object.

sections.p: 我把影片看完了 I finished watching the video (Taiwan 影片).
examples: ㄨㄛˇ ㄅㄚˇ ㄇㄣˊ ㄍㄨㄢ¯ ㄌㄜ˙ · Wǒ bǎ mén guān le.

drills.q: 我把影片看完了 uses Taiwan word…

sections.p: 杯子被我打破了 The cup was broken by me (spoken passive). News uses more 被 too.
examples: ㄊㄚ ㄅㄟˋ ㄩˇ ㄌㄧ�nˊ ㄕ¯ ㄌㄜ˙ · Tā bèi yǔ línshī le.
He got soaked by the rain.

sections.p: 連他都會 even he can; 連這個都不知道 don't even know this.

sections.p: 台灣口語常用 挺、蠻 instead of mainland 挺/很 alone: 蠻好的 pretty good.
